blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Volcanoes predominantly form at convergent boundaries, divergent boundaries, and intraplate hotspots.
Composite volcanoes are characterized by highly explosive eruptions.
Shield volcanoes are formed by low-viscosity, fluid lava flows.
Pyroclastic flows pose the greatest hazard among all volcanic phenomena.
Barren Island represents the sole active volcano located within India.
